sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil — the entire expression collapses to nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any single link is absent, the whole reaching returns nothing — the silence of a broken path.

sketches.mechanism: The 'fix' combinator finds the fixed point of a function — it defines something purely in terms of itself, an infinite self-reference that still resolves
sketches.resonance: The self is defined only by referring to itself; identity is a recursion that somehow converges.

sketches.mechanism: A finally block executes even when a return statement appears in the try block — the language guarantees the last word regardless of what the main logic decided
sketches.resonance: No matter what you choose, no matter how you try to leave, the goodbye always runs.
